verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents a card-creation API, and its card products can represent physical cards, so ordering a physical card through the API is implied. Nothing in the pack covers the personalization and fulfillment parts of the story. missing for 10: custom card art, bulk card orders, shipping method selection, shipment tracking, managed card-manufacturer/fulfillment documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can order personalized physical cards through the API — custom card art, bulk orders, shipping methods and tracking — without managing a card manufacturer relationship myself

citations.quote: You create a card using the `user_token` of the user who will own the card and the `card_product_token`
The card products resource represents the behavior and functionality of one or more cards (either physical or virtual).
